name: kibi-runtime
description: Narrow first-party runtime contracts and adapters for Kibi operations.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --packages bundle --define "$(node scripts/cli-version-define.mjs)" --external kibi-core --external kibi-plugin-builtin --external kibi-plugin-search-hints --external kibi-swipl --external 'kibi-swipl-*' && bun build ../cli/src/engine-daemon.ts --outfile dist/engine-daemon.js --target node --format esm --packages bundle --define "$(node scripts/cli-version-define.mjs)" --external kibi-core --external kibi-swipl --external 'kibi-swipl-*' && node -e "import('node:fs').then(f=>{f.rmSync('dist/skills',{recursive:true,force:true});f.mkdirSync('dist/skills',{recursive:true});f.cpSync('src/skills','dist/skills',{recursive:true});})"

author: Piotr Franczyk
